title: KKT Constrained Least Squares — Zero-Sum Target/Carry Share Conservation
principle_name: KKT Saddle-Point Block Solver for Share Conservation
evidence_quote: Projects post-Sinkhorn target/carry shares [WR1, WR2, WR3, TE1, RB1] onto exact zero-sum hyperplane sum(s_i)=1.0 via KKT solver (VMLS Ch. 16.2); constraint err = 5.55e-17
mechanism_quote: min ||x-b||^2 s.t. Cx=d with C=ones(1,n), d=[1.0]; x_clipped=[0.01,0.92], renormalized
how_it_influences_reasoning: Enforces exact target/carry sum conservation (sum=1.0) without padded arrays in simulate_matchup_pbp; BEFORE sum=1.015714 -> AFTER sum=1.0000000000
influence_description: Zero-sum projection of role shares; prevents share drift across simulated drives

title: FFT Compound Poisson PMF — Exact NFL Key-Number Pricing
principle_name: FFT Evaluation of Discrete Football Scoring PGFs
evidence_quote: Exact O(N log N) FFT evaluation of G_S(z)=exp(lambda(G_X(z)-1)) (Weber Lect. 13.4 & App. B); key numbers 3,6,7,10,14 priced with zero Gaussian rounding error; PMF sum = 1.00000000, E[S] = 22.845 pts
mechanism_quote: numpy FFT convolution of single-event PMF over n_grid=128; shootout_prob_ge51, stall_prob_le37, one_score_prob_le7 derived; KC@DEN P(|m|=3)=0.0648, P(|m|=7)=0.0569 vs Gaussian 0.0559/0.0505
how_it_influences_reasoning: Replaces Gaussian normal approximations with exact discrete FFT convolution for game-total and spread pricing; key-number masses on 3, 6, 7, 10, 14
influence_description: Exact discrete scoring-distribution pricing replacing Gaussian approximation

title: Cramér Large Deviation Tilt — Tail/Milestone Pricing
principle_name: Legendre-Fenchel Rate Function + Exponentially Tilted Measure
evidence_quote: Solves I(a)=sup_theta {theta a - ln M(theta)} and tilted measure p~_i = p_i e^(theta* x_i)/M(theta*) (Weber Lect. 24.1-24.2); theta*=0.2084, I(a)=0.2167, Chernoff_10d=0.11453; 30x-100x variance reduction on rare alt-lines and 2+ TD / 100+ yd milestones
mechanism_quote: Bisection/Newton solve for theta* matching target mean a; tilted PMF reweights tail events; Chernoff bound exp(-n*I(a)) for n drives
how_it_influences_reasoning: Prices tail props (2+ TDs, 100+ yards) and alt spreads via exponentially tilted measure; reduces Monte Carlo tail variance 30x-100x
influence_description: Cramér tilt for rare-event prop and alt-line pricing

title: Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Denoising — SGP Copula Covariance
principle_name: Spectral Random-Matrix Denoising Clips Noise Eigenvalues
evidence_quote: Clips noise eigenvalues inside [lambda_-, lambda_+] (Weber Lect. 12.2 & 24.3); clipped 9/12 noise modes on small NFL weekly samples; 6x6 simulated SGP leg correlation matrix denoised (sgp_corr_denoised, diag=[1.0,...])
mechanism_quote: Eigen-decompose raw 6x6 correlation; clip eigenvalues outside Marchenko-Pastur support; reconstruct denoised correlation with unit diagonal
how_it_influences_reasoning: Removes spurious noise eigenvalues from SGP leg correlation before copula pricing; prevents overconfident parlay legs on small weekly samples
influence_description: Spectral denoiser for 6x6 SGP pairwise correlation matrix

title: Two-Clocks Pressure Collision — NGS Time-to-Throw vs Defense Time-to-Pressure
evidence_quote: NGS average time-to-throw (snap-to-release): Caleb Williams 3.22s, Malik Willis 3.13s, Drake Maye 3.11s, Jordan Love 2.60s, Jacoby Brissett 2.63s, Jameis Winston 2.64s, Joe Burrow 2.64s (AM (1).md #3). Pressure wins the collision when defense time-to-pressure < QB time-to-throw; Williams (3.22s) vs GB (~2.29s) yields pressure_advantage_sec = -1.18 with Big Nickel run-blitz adj.
mechanism_quote: effective_t2p = def_t2p - (0.25 if big_nickel_run_blitz else 0.0); pressure_advantage_sec = effective_t2p - qb_ttt; collision = pressure_advantage_sec < 0
how_it_influences_reasoning: Flags QB/defense matchups where pressure arrives before release (negative pressure_advantage_sec), elevating sack probability and INT hazard; Big Nickel 37% early-down run-blitz shrinks the QB window by ~0.25s.
influence_description: QB time-to-throw vs defense time-to-pressure collision detector with Big Nickel confounder

title: First-Half Scoring Differential Tiers & Net Points Off Turnovers Ledger
principle_name: First-Half Differential Tiers + Turnover-Fragility Variance Modifier
evidence_quote: 1H scoring differential tiers through W7: IND +10.0, SEA +8.7, KC +7.9, GB +3.1, NYJ -10.6, TEN -9.1, CIN -8.6 (AM (1).md #5). Positive 1H diff = faster start; high net pts off TO = ball-secure (lower variance); negative net = fragile (higher variance).
mechanism_quote: first_half_margin_shift = 0.10 * (home_prior - away_prior); to_volatility_adj = -0.12 * avg_net_pts_to / 35.0; sigma_margin/sigma_total compressed for ball-secure teams, inflated for fragile teams
how_it_influences_reasoning: Shifts the simulated margin toward the team with the better 1H differential prior and adjusts score variance by turnover fragility: GB/NYJ (positive net TO) compress variance, NO (negative) inflates it.
influence_description: 1H differential prior spread shift plus turnover-fragility variance modifier

title: Nash Equilibrium — 55% Early-Down Pass vs Light Box

mechanism_quote: indifference condition: offense pass share ~0.55 vs light box; deviation by either side is exploitable by the other
how_it_influences_reasoning: Anchors early-down pass/run balance: offenses passing materially off the ~55% equilibrium vs light boxes are exploitable; defenses off-equilibrium surrender EPA on the other side.
influence_description: 55% early-down pass Nash equilibrium vs light box

title: Benjamini-Hochberg Multiple-Testing Gate & Pre-Registered Opponent-Adjusted Grading Bar
principle_name: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Control + Pre-Registered Opponent-Adjusted Grading
evidence_quote: Benjamini-Hochberg multiple-testing gate applied across 77-market prop sweeps to control false-discovery rate when grading player props (AM (1).md #11). Pre-Registered Opponent-Adjusted Grading Bar requires prop grades to be set against opponent-adjusted baselines pre-registration, not post-hoc vs league average (AM (1).md #A1).
mechanism_quote: sort p-values ascending; reject H_(i) when p_(i) <= (i/m) * q with m=77 markets; grade props vs opponent-adjusted baseline registered before settlement
how_it_influences_reasoning: Controls FDR across 77 simultaneous prop-market tests so graded edges aren't noise; opponent-adjusted pre-registered bars prevent grading inflation from weak-opponent schedules.
influence_description: BH FDR gate over 77 prop markets plus pre-registered opponent-adjusted grading bar
